units.source_text: 同样是在雪国，但驹子所在的温泉乡，房檐并不相连。

en.t: It was likewise in snow country, but in the hot-spring village where Komako lived, the eaves were not joined together.

units.source_text: 岛村到了这个镇子，才头一回看到这种“雁木”。

en.t: Only after Shimamura came to this town did he see such ganki arcades for the first time.

units.source_text: 好奇心促使他走过去看了看，只见破旧的房檐下十分昏暗。

en.t: Curiosity drew him over to have a look, and he found it very dim beneath the dilapidated eaves.
The bases of the leaning pillars had already rotted away.

units.source_text: 令人觉得仿佛是在窥视世世代代被埋没在雪里的忧郁的人家一样。

en.t: It made him feel as though he were peering into the gloomy homes of families buried in snow for generations.
